episode.title: A Is Amazing
episode.learning_goal: Letter A — Apple and Airplane — A is Amazing
episode.learning_goal_age_appropriate: Words that start with the letter A — like apple and airplane — are amazing, and A is the first letter of the alphabet.

part_2_story_setup.content: 8-beat story — apple and airplane discovery, warm mistake, letter A reveal, call-and-response, count-in

part_3_song_block.content: Star burst transition + A Is Amazing full song

part_4_wrap_up.content: Recap dialogue — apple, airplane, letter A — proud moment, take-home A challenge

part_5_closing_sting.content: Show logo, ukulele hit, Sunny goodbye on yellow porch

story_concept.research_principle_1: Object-first — show apple and airplane before naming the letter A
story_concept.research_principle_2: Call-and-response — viewer says A words with Sunny before song
story_concept.research_principle_3: Physical movement cues — crunch the apple, fly like a plane, jump on A A A
story_concept.research_principle_4: Goodbye as reward — wrap-up validates viewer's effort, take-home challenge gives agency
story_concept.opening_situation: Sunny invites viewers in and heads to Nana Blossom's porch. Nana is holding a basket of apples.
story_concept.discovery_1: Mia spots the apple — big red, shiny, delicious. Everyone investigates it.
story_concept.discovery_2: Leo's paper airplane sails in — he made it himself. Everyone investigates it.
story_concept.warm_mistake: Leo guesses apple and airplane are the same because they're both red. Mia gently points out the airplane is white. No shame — just noticing.
story_concept.turning_point: Nana Blossom holds up the letter A card — apple and airplane both start with A!
story_concept.call_and_response: Sunny leads viewers through two direct-address questions — what does apple start with? What does airplane start with? — with 3-second viewer response holds.
story_concept.song_moment: Mimi runs in barefoot and asks to sing. Count-in, Star Burst transition, full A Is Amazing song.
story_concept.lesson_delivered: Letter A — apple and airplane — and A is AMAZING.
story_concept.audience_takeaway: Find one A word at your home today.
